Namita Kukreja
Software Development Engineer II
linkedin.com/in/namita-kukreja   ·   github.com/namitakukreja   ·   nkukreja6228@gmail.com   ·   Pune, India   ·   +91-8109914707
SUMMARY
SDE-II with 7+ years of backend engineering experience across microservices, distributed systems, and REST API design, 
complemented by frontend work in ReactJS/Redux. Currently specialized in AI and LLM-powered tooling, architecting agentic 
systems, RAG pipelines, and vector database integrations at Autodesk, including Cursor/Claude MCP workflows. Proven 
track record of platform-scale delivery across Autodesk, Dassault Systèmes, and Persistent Systems.
WORK EXPERIENCE
Autodesk   |   Pune, India Aug 2022 – Present
Software Development Engineer II
Stack: Node.js · Python · AWS · Microservices · Agentic AI
Client-Side SDK Architecture
• Designed and delivered a layered SDK abstraction over Autodesk's design platform.
• Enforced cross-layer data integrity and controlled metadata propagation across storage and retrieval services.
• Exposed clean, versioned developer-facing APIs over complex internal engineering models.
APS JSON Protocol Migration
• Architected migration of legacy XML-based changeset formats to a lightweight APS JSON exchange protocol.
• Reduced average API payload from ~850 KB to ~510 KB (~40% reduction).
• Delivered measurable latency improvements across Autodesk's design ecosystem.
OneGraph Query Microservice
• Designed and shipped a standalone filtered-read microservice over large-scale asset graphs (~50M+ nodes).
• Selected and tuned the winning data store for read-heavy query patterns, with targeted index redesign that cut p95 
query latency by ~30%.
• Added rate limiting and structured error boundaries (circuit breakers) across all APIs, unifying service parity across 4+ 
independently deployed instances.
LLM Expert-Routing System (RAG + Vector DB)
• Prototyped an org-wide agentic AI routing system using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
• Enabled semantic expert discovery across 500+ engineers with automated dual-party notifications.
• Built continuous self-learning from resolved queries, eliminating repeat-query overhead.
Cursor & Claude MCP Integration
• Integrated Cursor and Claude MCP into engineering workflows, automating code review gating and cursor-rule-driven PR 
standards.
• Built semantic Confluence search to surface relevant documentation during development.
• Reduced team-wide LLM token overhead from ~1.4M to ~910K tokens/week (~35% reduction) via prompt engineering, 
reusable templates, and context pruning.
Dassault Systèmes   |   Pune, India May 2021 – Aug 2022
R&D Development Engineer
Stack: ReactJS · Redux · Node.js · MySQL
myMedidata Clinical-Trial Portal
• Built the ReactJS/Redux frontend for the global myMedidata patient portal.
• Delivered multi-locale support across 15+ regional deployments, serving thousands of clinical-trial participants 
worldwide.
Node.js REST API Ownership
• Owned end-to-end Node.js REST API integrations on a production-critical healthcare platform, from incident triage and 
root-cause analysis through hotfix deployment.
• Maintained SLA-level high availability across releases.
Test Quality
• Authored unit and integration test suites sustaining >85% code coverage.
• Reduced regression defects by ~20% quarter-over-quarter across release cycles.
Persistent Systems Limited   |   Nagpur, India Aug 2018 – May 2021
Software Engineer
Stack: Node.js · Loopback · Java · Redis · Jenkins
Enterprise AppConnect Connectors
• Designed and shipped 7+ production REST connectors on Node.js/Loopback for Salesforce, AWS DynamoDB, GCS, 
FileNet, and OracleTaleo.
• Built each with full CRUD, configurable field mapping, error handling, and retry logic.
Auth & Security
• Implemented OAuth2, Cookie-based, and Basic auth flows across all connector surfaces.
• Handled token refresh, session management, and expiry, meeting enterprise security and compliance standards.
Backend Performance & Reliability
• Profiled connector performance via Grafana/Metis, resolving bottlenecks that improved throughput by ~25%.
• Maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines with zero-downtime deployment practices across connector releases.
Java Integration Layer
• Built Java-based integration bridges for FileNet and legacy on-prem systems.
• Enabled bi-directional data sync with the AppConnect middleware platform, extending connector coverage to systems 
without native REST support.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: JavaScript (Node.js), Python, Java, SQL
Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express, Loopback, Flask, REST APIs, OAuth2, Microservices, API Design, Rate Limiting, Circuit 
Breakers
AI & LLM: Agentic AI, RAG Pipelines, LangGraph, Vector Databases, Embeddings, Semantic Search, LLM Tool Use, Cursor MCP, 
Claude MCP, Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering, NumPy, scikit-learn, PySpark, Databricks
Frontend: ReactJS, Redux, HTML5, CSS3
Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, DynamoDB (AWS), Redis, IBM CloudantDB
Cloud & DevOps: AWS (DynamoDB, SNS), IBM Cloud, Docker, OpenShift, Jenkins, CI/CD
Testing: Jest, Cucumber, Mocha/Chai, JUnit, Mockito/Powermockito
Tools: Git, Postman, Jira, VS Code, Grafana, LogDNA, Maven, Dynatrace, Splunk, Catchpoint
System Design: Layered Architecture, Service-Oriented Architecture, Distributed Systems, Graph Data Models, Index 
Optimization
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS & RECOGNITION
• Site-Level Tech Talk — APS.JSON: Selected to present Autodesk's APS JSON protocol migration to the broader 
engineering site, driving org-wide awareness and accelerating cross-team adoption beyond the immediate product 
squad.
• First AI-tooling champion on the team — pioneered Cursor & Claude MCP adoption, establishing reusable prompt 
templates and cursor rules that became org-wide engineering assets.
• Connector platform expansion at Persistent Systems — grew AppConnect coverage from 3 to 10+ enterprise 
integrations in under 3 years.
